Vijay's Cauvery talks plan with Karnataka sparks controversy in Tamil Nadu

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister CM Vijay has proposed a plan to discuss the Cauvery water dispute with Karnataka. The proposal was met with criticism from opposition parties, who alleged that it would benefit Karnataka at the expense of Tamil Nadu. Meanwhile, some outlets highlighted concerns over infrastructure development in Tamil Nadu, citing airport and sewage issues. The government said that the talks were necessary to resolve the long-standing dispute. Police claimed that protests against the plan were being organized by opposition groups.
